summary: Tested FR/EN instant translation feature across all pages. All translation functionality works correctly: Navigation (8 elements), Dashboard (5 tabs), Shop page, Admin page (18 tabs), Trips page, and language persistence in localStorage.

features_tested.notes: Language toggle via FR/EN spans works correctly. Clicking FR switches to French, clicking EN switches to English. Language stored in localStorage key 'bionic_language'.
All navigation items translate correctly. FR: ACCUEIL, TABLEAU DE BORD, INTELLIGENCE, CARTE, SORTIES, ANALYSEZ, MAGASIN. EN: HOME, DASHBOARD, INTELLIGENCE, MAP, TRIPS, ANALYZE, SHOP.
All 5 dashboard tabs translate correctly. FR: Vue d'ensemble, Météo, Analyse, Stratégie, Assistant IA. EN: Overview, Weather, Analysis, Strategy, AI Assistant.
Shop page title and messages translate correctly. FR: Magasin, Tous les produits, Aucun résultat trouvé. EN: Shop, All products, No results found.

All 18 admin tabs translate correctly. FR: Tableau de bord, Ventes, Produits, Partenaires, Clients, Commissions, Performances, Catégories, Contenu SEO, BACKUP, Accès Site, Hotspots, Réseautage, Email, Marketing, Partenaires, Contrôles, Identité. EN: Dashboard, Sales, Products, Partners, Customers, Commissions, Performance, Categories, SEO Content, BACKUP, Site Access, Hotspots, Networking, Email, Marketing, Partners, Controls, Identity.
Trips page title translates correctly. FR: Sorties de Chasse. EN: Hunting Trips. Stats labels also translate: Total sorties/Total Trips, Taux de succès/Success Rate.
Language preference persists in localStorage (key: 'bionic_language'). After page reload, selected language is maintained.
Overall design is professional and tactical. However, NutritionCard components in CoreDashboard.jsx still use emoji icons (🥩, 💎, 🦌, ⏱️) instead of Lucide icons. This is a minor design inconsistency.

issues: Emoji icons (🥩, 💎, 🦌, ⏱️) still used instead of Lucide icons in CoreDashboard.jsx lines 219, 226, 233, 240
